name: ecc
description: Unified Multi-Harness Architecture: Claude Code boilerplates (ecc-claude), Agnostic Antigravity distribution (ecc-agy), and Home-Lab specialized fork (ecc-agy-homelab).
author: ACB75

ecc-claude.description: Official ECC boilerplates and artifacts directly optimized for Anthropic Claude Code.

ecc-agy.description: Pure, project-agnostic Google Antigravity distribution with 16 skills, 12 agents, and SRE baseline reusable across N projects.

ecc-agy-homelab.description: Specialized fork containing home-lab governance, portal sync, cluster, kakebo, whoiam, and multi-tier promotion.
